name: Su-30MK Community Mod
summary: Community Su-30MK/SM family multirole fighter mod for DCS World with custom EFM.
description:
Flyable Su-30 variants with a custom EFM, distributed via Google Drive links in the ED forum thread. An optional CWS add-on makes it standalone; without it some variants rely on Flaming Cliffs aircraft.

Requires: Optional CWS add-on (separate download) for standalone weapon systems; without CWS the BVR variant reportedly needs FC3/Su-33.
